sources.label: 2024 presidential margin
sources.description: Results minus the 2024 presidential Democratic margin. County files are compatible with statewide race detail maps.
sourceNotes: Use certified county returns or MEDSL-style county presidential returns.
Normalize by county FIPS with demVotes, repVotes, totalVotes, demShare, repShare, margin.

sources.label: 2020 presidential margin
sources.description: Results minus the 2020 presidential Democratic margin. County files are compatible with statewide race detail maps.
sourceNotes: Use certified county returns or MEDSL-style county presidential returns.
Normalize by county FIPS with demVotes, repVotes, totalVotes, demShare, repShare, margin.

sources.label: 2024 House margin
sources.description: Results minus the 2024 House district Democratic margin. House baselines are district-level only unless split-county returns are added later.
sourceNotes: Use official state returns or MIT/MEDSL-style district House returns.
County pieces stay dim because this baseline is district-level, not split-county.

sources.label: Last Senate margin
sources.description: Results minus the most comparable recent Senate general-election margin for the seat cycle where available, instead of blindly using the latest Senate race in the state.
sourceNotes: For current 2026 coverage, use the same-seat-cycle baseline where available, such as Collins 2020 instead of King 2024 in Maine.
If the same-cycle baseline is unavailable, fall back to the latest usable Senate statewide baseline and note that fallback in the generated source file.

sources.label: Last governor margin
sources.description: Results minus the most recent comparable governor general-election margin in that state.
sourceNotes: Uses previous gubernatorial general-election margins from the FEA governor forecast input file.
This is state-level only. Replace with certified governor returns when a complete statewide governor returns source is added.
